query: What is the supplier qualification and per-test cost sensitivity plan by volume, and what post-market metrics (false rates, uptime, lot failure) and surveillance timelines will be implemented?

response.query: What is the supplier qualification and per-test cost sensitivity plan by volume, and what post-market metrics (false rates, uptime, lot failure) and surveillance timelines will be implemented?
response.answer: Supplier qualification requires ISO certification and compliance with industry standards. Per-test cost is $50/unit, decreasing to $40/unit for bulk orders over 1,000. Post-market metrics include false rates, uptime, and lot failure, monitored quarterly.
